title: About The Hook Breaks Open
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 16 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @archivepilled: Claude Monet, 'Iris' (c. 1924-25). A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Hook Breaks Open: Landscape painting of two unequal iris foliage islands across a broad blue-lilac interval. A dominant hooked forest-green blade arches partway across the gap; smaller spears and crossing leaves stop short. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Long arching forest-green iris blade with a broken teal edge and Long hooked forest-green iris blade with broken teal brushstroke edge.
